title: Blitzscaling 08: Eric Schmidt on Structuring Teams and Scaling Google
summary: Stanford Blitzscaling class session where Reid Hoffman interviews Eric Schmidt about structuring teams and scaling Google. Topics include Alphabet, hiring, and how Chrome and Android operated inside the company.
why: Cited as a first-hand source for how Google's leadership thought about hiring, organization and the Alphabet restructuring.

quote.text: if you're interested in some of the motivation and types of problems they're trying to solve with it
